query:
-- Million Dollar Quartet
UPDATE projects 
SET seoKeywords = 'scenic design, Million Dollar Quartet, Sun Records, South Coast Repertory, 1950s Memphis, rock and roll'
WHERE slug = 'million-dollar-quartet';

INSERT IGNORE INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id 
FROM projects p
CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.slug = 'million-dollar-quartet'
AND t.name IN ('1950s', 'Recording Studio', 'Rock and Roll', 'Regional Theatre', 'Co-Design', '2025', 'Musical Theatre');

-- Much Ado About Nothing
UPDATE projects 
SET seoKeywords = 'scenic design, Much Ado About Nothing, Shakespeare, western, New Swan Theatre, saloon'
WHERE slug = 'much-ado-about-nothing';

INSERT IGNORE INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id 
FROM projects p
CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.slug = 'much-ado-about-nothing'
AND t.name IN ('Shakespeare', 'Wild West', 'Spaghetti Western', 'Saloon Design', 'Theatre Festival', '2025', 'Comedy');

-- Lysistrata
UPDATE projects 
SET seoKeywords = 'scenic design, Lysistrata, Greek comedy, Aristophanes, New Swan Theatre, minimalist'
WHERE slug = 'lysistrata';

INSERT IGNORE INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id 
FROM projects p
CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.slug = 'lysistrata'
AND t.name IN ('Minimalist', 'Unit Set', 'Theatre Festival', '2024', 'Comedy', 'Classic Play');
